author: Ari Koslow
title: Konnor Pilkington signs minor league deal with Nationals
desc: The Nationals signed LHP Konnor Pilkington to a minor-league deal.
impact: Pilkington was recently released by the Tigers. He will add more pitching depth in the Nationals organization.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Wilkin Ramos sent outright by Giants
desc: The Giants sent RHP Wilkin Ramos outright to Triple-A Sacramento.
impact: Ramos went unclaimed on waivers. He will remain in the Giants organization.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Dedniel Nunez (elbow) sent on rehab assignment
desc: The Mets sent RHP Dedniel Núñez on a rehab assignment to Double-A Binghamton.
impact: Nunez is working his way back from Tommy John surgery. He'll require a lengthy rehab assignment.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ryan Jeffers (hamate) hits for third straight day Wednesday
desc: Twins manager Derek Shelton said Ryan Jeffers hit for a third straight day on Wednesday.
impact: Jeffers is getting close to a rehab assignment. He has been sidelined since late May.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jefry Yan has contract selected by Mets, optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Mets selected the contract of Jefry Yan from Triple-A Syracuse and optioned him to Triple-A Syracuse.
impact: Yan will remain in Triple-A, but he gets a spot on the 40-man roster for the Mets.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Liam Hendriks throws scoreless inning for Triple-A Iowa Wednesday
desc: Liam Hendriks threw a scoreless inning for Triple-A Iowa on Wednesday.
impact: Hendriks signed a minor league contract with the Cubs back in May. He'll likely get a handful of appearances in Triple-A before potentially getting an opportunity in the majors.

author: Nate Miller
title: Alan Rangel effective in first career start
desc: Alan Rangel allowed three hits and four walks while striking out four across four scoreless innings in Thursday's 6-1 loss to the Pirates.
impact: Rangel did his part for the Phillies on Thursday afternoon. The same cannot be said for the Philly bullpen. After pitching behind an opener in each of his previous two outings, Rangel made his first official MLB start Thursday. He did issue four free passes over four frames, but he also navigated choppy waters to keep the Pirates off the scoreboard. The 28-year-old righty fired 90 pitches on the afternoon, and it seems he may be ready to hold down a spot at the back of the Phillies' rotation for a while. Rangel now holds a solid 3.38 ERA and 1.31 WHIP with 17 strikeouts through 16 big-league innings so far this season.

author: Nate Miller
title: Scott Barlow signs with Royals
desc: Scott Barlow has agreed to a minor league contract with the Royals.
impact: Barlow was released by the Athletics this past week after he was designated for assignment and cleared waivers. The veteran reliever will now return to the organization with which he made his MLB debut back in 2018 and pitched for until being traded away in the middle of the 2023 season. Barlow did pick up a couple of saves for the Athletics earlier this season, but he struggled overall, posting a 6.48 ERA over 36 appearances.

author: Ari Koslow
title: David Bednar activated from paternity list
desc: The Yankees activated David Bednar from the paternity list.
impact: Bednar was away from the team for a few days. He'll return to his closer role in the Yankees bullpen.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ricky Tiedemann getting some injections in his neck
desc: Blue Jays pitching prospect Ricky Tiedemann is getting some injections in his neck.
impact: Tiedemann suffered a setback on his rehab assignment after feeling discomfort in his neck/shoulder area.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Patrick Sandoval (biceps) could return next week
desc: Patrick Sandoval is in play to return from the injured list last week.
impact: Sandoval is an option with Connelly Early going down in his latest start. He made his latest rehab start last weekend on Saturday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Cooper Hjerpe (elbow) activated from 60-day IL
desc: Cooper Hjerpe has been activated from the injured list.
impact: Hjerpe had been on the 60-day IL.

author: Ari Koslow
title: AJ Blubaugh drawing trade interest
desc: The Astros are reportedly drawing trade interest in AJ Blubaugh.
impact: Blubaugh has a 2.06 ERA in 48 innings since April 8. He is one of several bullpen arms for Houston drawing trade interest.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Jung Hoo Lee swipes base in win over Diamondbacks
desc: Jung Hoo Lee went 2-for-4 in Wednesday's 6-4 win over the Diamondbacks with two runs scored, one RBI, and one stolen base.
impact: Lee continues a solid stretch of late, getting on base in 10 of his last 15 contests. The outfielder continues to reward manager Tony Vitello as one of the more impactful options in the Giants lineup, slashing .319 with five home runs, 43 runs scored, 32 RBI, and six stolen bases across 78 games.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Zac Gallen struggles late Wednesday
desc: Zac Gallen allowed six runs on seven hits over 5 2/3 innings with four strikeouts and one walk in a loss on Wednesday against the Giants.
impact: Gallen had started his outing throwing four scoreless frames before things took a turn quickly. He is off the fantasy radar at this point.
